messages:
maya: Quick pulse — sampleapps matrix + changelog cutoff. We need owners for all lanes (python/node, linux/mac, node16/18, py3.10/3.11). Please post 1-line status + any PR numbers by EOD. cc @priya @jon :wave:

jon: Taking python lane (samples/python). Matrix: py3.10 linux, py3.11 linux+mac. Current blocker: wheel build failing on mac due to numpy / wheel-sandbox. See PR #842 (attempted fix). Will try a vendor wheel if build fails again.

priya: Assigned node lanes. Local tests pass for node16/18. CI has intermittent docker auth errors — filed infra issue #198. I have PRs #860 (deps bump) and #861 (sampleapp fixes) ready.

carlos: @priya saw the registry flaps earlier. I queued a runner pool refresh and bumped timeout. Recommend adding a 2x retry on the docker pull step in the CI job for now.

sam-ci: CI bot: integration:node-http failed 2 times in last 6h; flaky. link: https://ci.redwood/xy/1221

priya: I can add retries to the job (quick change) and also submit a smaller-image branch that removes dev deps (PR #870). That brings image down from 140MB -> 95MB.

jon: Python wheel size is inflated by vendored model binaries. Option: move model download to startup step for quickstarts. That changes demo behavior though.

maya: Decision needed before changelog cut: trim image size (smaller, faster pulls) OR keep current demo parity. Please react with :thumbsup: for smaller image, :thumbsdown: to keep parity.

carlos: :thumbsup: smaller images (infra wins on faster pulls & fewer timeouts).

jon: :thumbsup: smaller images but add a changelog note that model download moved to first-run.

priya: :thumbsup: will merge #870 and #861 if CI green. I'll also post changelog bullets: node sampleapp updates: #861, #860.

maya: OK — plan: priya merges node PRs + #870; jon merges or posts status for #842; carlos to monitor registry and add job retry; I'll assemble changelog bullets and add placeholders for anything unmerged by cutoff. Ping at 16:00 PT for final signoff. :eyes:
